name: CAENL checkpoint robustness and practical cost diagnostics v1
role: Separately specified follow-up using frozen final models; no change to the training protocol or its analysis family

robustness.radius_unit: pixel levels divided by 255 in [0,1] RGB space
robustness.suite: standard unmodified AutoAttack: apgd-ce, apgd-t, fab-t, square
robustness.precision: FP32 parameters and input, no autocast, deterministic evaluation
robustness.multiplicity: One separate three-contrast family, Holm separately for paired-t and exact sign-flip tests; not programme-wide error control
robustness.secondary: Other radii, clean accuracy, same-clean-correct intersection, clean/adversarial geometry, feature displacement, margins and local margin-gradient L1 proxies are descriptive; no certificate or causal mediation claim
robustness.returned_geometry: AutoAttack returns unchanged inputs for initially incorrect examples and a mixture of successful perturbations and surviving examples from its constituent attacks; geometry describes this returned mixture, not uniformly perturbed inputs. Movement and margins are additionally summarized by clean-error, successful-attack and survivor groups.
robustness.stopping: Exactly 30 specified final models and all five radii, regardless of signs or significance; no best checkpoint, radius or seed selection

cost.scope: Short in-memory training-path benchmark on common cached real data, fresh optimizer and fixed starting weights; modified weights discarded. Not scientific retraining, convergence evidence, full-job runtime, or performance of a newly optimized method
cost.boundary: Data cache setup and model construction reported separately; time includes measured training steps, device transfers, faithful controller operations and holdout monitoring when the condition uses them; no serialization, acquisition or attack time
cost.tuning_cost: Record actual completed grid costs by family; earlier controller development cost remains unknown, not zero
cost.interpretation: Microbenchmark timing repetitions are not independent scientific training seeds; no claim that adaptation improves prediction or universally saves tuning
